notes: Claim statuses travel: softmax/argmax and preference gauge Derived, J-space/EBM/operational-parity Offered. No scene claims an implemented system; each keeps the record's own Open/Offered boundary.

Rework 2026-10-07 (craft lane 4): word-labels replaced by drawn formal structure. Softmax is the bar field itself — weights (1,2,4) normalise to Σ=1, +10 repeats the same bars (invariance shown, not said), T=2 softens to (1,√2,2), T→0 gathers mass one-hot, T→∞ flattens uniform: temperature read as geometry. The gauge is a beam: tilt 3/4, shift inert (identical plate), swap mirrors to 1/4, ×2 steepens to 9/10, the new reference levels it to 1/2. J-space is a permission graph: the ✕ edge redrawn ▶ by a policy change — the reachable set is the drawing. EBM is the bowl: (y−θ)², the domain {0,1} moving the minimum, learning shifting θ, and the frame notation (m,θ,E)→(m′,θ′,E′) for the second-order revision. Parity is the hexagon circuit E1–E6 around the promoted distinction, failure named first, receipt returned.

Colour: three grounds — cool workshop #10131a (the two Derived scenes), lamplight #16120e (the two Offered constructions), ember walk #141210 (parity). Palette and tints travel ivory→steel→brass→ember; gold reserved for the earned openings (T→0 cut, publish open, receipt).

Stillness: pairs softmax/gauge and J-space/EBM hold field, engine, view and morph byte-identical while the drawn plates hand over — rest between scenes of one register; motion at the register changes (and into the vortex walk of parity).
Stage text is eight-one words across five scenes; claim metadata and routing live only in this binding and the field's connections panel.

Deepen 2026-10-07 (lane 4): the two Offered constructions stand in 3d — in J-space the third dimension is the horizon the boundary hides: the drawn square recedes to z −0.55 behind its action graph (z 0) while the lens J stands before the field (z +0.32), circumscription shown with its circumstance; in the EBM the third dimension is the descent itself — the bowl's far wall at z −0.3, θ at the deepest point of the valley (z −0.5), the declared domain turned toward the inquirer (z +0.28). The pair keeps its shared world (view yaw 0.35 pitch 0.42, perspective, vortex3d 0.45) so the rest between them is still a rest.

Deepen, morph: the material is alive — J-space and EBM share one morph clock (toroidalHopf trajectory, smooth drive, law theta, θ̇ 0.07 φ̇ 0.11, depth 0.9): the held field breathes, the bowl turns slowly under its own gravity; parity's circuit morphs on a vortexSpiral (triangle drive, θ̇ 0.14, depth 1.2) — the six-test walk circles the promoted distinction and stretches the ember grain (elongation 0.16).

Deepen, physics states: three profiles across the journey — crisp workshop (grain 0.03, halo 0.1, roundness 0.97, softness 0.12, irregularity 0.22) for the two Derived plates; deep offered field (depth 0.42, zConfinement 0.72, halo 0.2, softness 0.3) for J-space and EBM; ember walk (irregularity 0.5, contrast 0.95, elongation 0.16) for parity. Particle props vary across the journey and hold within each register's rest.

Deepen, titles: every scene now carries the record's own line — softmax 'The distribution, maximum selection and random draw' (#2), gauge 'It therefore leaves every probability unchanged' (#1), J-space 'Permission is an operative condition' (#2), EBM 'Optimisation over y, learning over θ' (#2), parity 'Varying it changes a declared operation' (#0). Stage words 103; no metadata on stage.
description: Computation mathemes: softmax/argmax, preference gauge and reference policy, J-space, energy-based inference, the six operational-parity tests.

enrichment.note: provenance normalisation 2026-10-06: source_revision.commit records the revision the preserved records[] hashes resolve at (dbf3b17, the basis this binding inherited); the enrichment read the records at read_revision fc59a719 (see enrichment notes for moved/deleted records).

glyph_rationales.argmax: the actual cut — one index taken out of the retained field, gold at the maxima
glyph_rationales.≻: the paired-comparison relation itself — preference, not levels; the gauge reads only differences
glyph_rationales.J: the bounded judgment field J(B,ℓ,φ,s) — the operative condition the actions stand in, not metadata
glyph_rationales.softmax bars — the weight field under te: the distribution drawn: exp weights as bars, temperature as their spread — the record's own worked example
glyph_rationales.the retained field around the cut: the field kept with a selection — logits, temperature, candidates, rule — so the answer can return through its conditions
glyph_rationales.the gauge beam — two scores, one differe: P(i≻j)=σ(r_i−r_j): a beam that reads only the difference between two pans
glyph_rationales.the reference policy: the floor the comparison stands on — shiftable, and when it moves the comparisons move
glyph_rationales.the permission graph — three actions, on: inspect, edit, publish with the withheld edge — permission as an operative condition, drawn as reachability
glyph_rationales.the bounded field: the boundary of J-space — circumscription; the square that holds the actions and hides its own horizon
glyph_rationales.the energy landscape — a bowl and its mi: E_θ(y)=(y−θ)² — inference as descent; the minimum, the domain cut into it, the learning that shifts it
glyph_rationales.θ: the parameter — what learning revises, distinct from the candidate y that inference selects
glyph_rationales.the declared domain: {0,1} — the feasible set inference is confined to; a constitutive condition, not an afterthought
glyph_rationales.the six discriminating tests — one circu: E1–E6: seam, gauge, lens, continuity, recursion, return — a distinction earns promotion by circling all six
glyph_rationales.the promoted distinction — what all six: the candidate distinction under test — promoted only if varying it changes a declared operation
glyph_rationales.the receipt: the returned outcome — conditions, intervention, result, alternatives, failures — capable of revising the design
